title: Three Days and One Short Bone
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：jaw　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 jaw 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the zookeeper ① drew the jaw that no student in the enclosure would have recorded, and he said the drawing was the whole of the week. The ② jaw, meaning the mouth itself and not the bone, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a jaw, he said, is the only thing in an enclosure that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ jaw in that enclosure had the same short bone beside it, and the ④ jaw at the far pool, meaning the tooth they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A jaw, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the zookeeper said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the jaw was the whole of the matter, meaning the bite and not the mouth. The ⑥ jaw, meaning the bite and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; jaw, he said, is either something you draw or the only word that means both a mouth and a bite. He said the bite is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ jaw had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short bone. The ⑧ jaw of the whole thing, the zookeeper wrote in April, was one enclosure and three weeks of recording; jaw, he said, is either the tooth at the far pool or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ jaw I remember is the mouth recorded in the chart, which closed in 2000 and is still recorded as the quietest in the enclosure. A ⑩ jaw, my mother said in 2002, is the only mouth that improves by being recorded; every jaw, she said, is a bite that has agreed to look like a mouth. She said the bite was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 颌；下巴（指围栏区里每一副旁边的那一副）
B. n. 颌；下巴（指那副口部本身，与骨头相对）
C. 固定搭配：draw the jaw 描绘这副颌骨
D. n. 颌；下巴（指留给孩子们数的一颗那一副）
E. n. 齿颌之事（抽象总称，指一处围栏区的颌之事）
F. n. 颌；下巴（指图表里写到、被记下的的那一副）
G. n. 咬合、威力（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 威力（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: drew the jaw that no student in the enclosure would have recorded
The jaw, meaning the mouth itself and not the bone
the jaw at the far pool
the jaw was the whole of the matter
the jaw had become a line in a chart
The jaw of the whole thing
A jaw, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: draw the jaw 意为“描绘这副颌骨”，1993 年那位饲养员把围栏区里没有一位学生肯记录的一副颌骨做了一遍。
jaw 意为“颌；下巴”，指那副口部本身而不是骨头，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记录。
jaw 意为“颌；下巴”，指围栏区里每一副旁边的那一副，每一副旁边都有同一根短短的骨头。
jaw 意为“颌；下巴”，指最远那个水池留给孩子们数的一颗那一副，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
jaw 意为“咬合、威力”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次咬合就是那件事的全部。
jaw 意为“威力”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那副口部，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
jaw 意为“颌；下巴”，指图表里写到、被记下的的那一副，到 1998 年这一副成了图表里的一行。
jaw 意为“齿颌之事”，饲养员四月写道，整件事的颌之事是一处围栏区和三个星期的记录。
jaw 意为“颌；下巴”，我记得的是图表里记录过的那一副，2000 年量完了，至今仍被说成围栏区里最安静的一副。
jaw 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，颌是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的口部。

那处围栏区里每一副颌旁边都有同一根短短的骨头。（jaw）
